header: An EMPTY HEALTH CHECK-UP ANSWER FOR A DATE now says WHY (step 61a; open item "empty answer for a date with no check-up"). "who has the health check-up on 4 January 2026?" used to say only "Nothing was found. The health check-up lists in the system are: ...". I made it also say what kind of day it was and which dates the list of that month HAS: "4 January 2026 is a Sunday. The health check-up dates in January 2026 are 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 ...". I read this from the data (nlq.health_checkups), never from the model; it returns null when there is nothing to add.

symbols.name: dateAsked
symbols.sig: export function dateAsked(sql: string): string | null
doc: Returns the date a health check-up SQL filtered on (checkup_date = '2026-01-04'), or null.

symbols.name: emptyDateNote
symbols.sig: export async function emptyDateNote(run: RunQuery, iso: string): Promise<string | null>
doc: Gives "4 January 2026 is a Sunday. The health check-up dates in January 2026 are 1, 2, 3 and 5." or null when there is no list for that month (the answer already says so).

behaviours: the date is read from the SQL that ran
a range, a month, no filter, or an impossible date gives none
4 January 2026 (the empty answer HC-9): 'is a Sunday' and the dates of January 2026
...the month and the year are what the query asks for
a Date object and a timestamp string are read too
no list for that month -> null (the answer already says there is none)
a database failure -> null, never an exception
the pipeline adds the note to an empty answer that asked for a date (and only there)
